status: Independent editorial classification; not a metrological standard, certification or performance ranking.
scope: Gravity-measurement instruments. Gravity gradiometers are related but distinct and are not automatically included.

measurement_type.relative: Reports gravity differences relative to a reference or across observation locations.
measurement_type.absolute: Reports local gravity acceleration using the instrument stated absolute measurement method.

sensing_family.quartz_sensor: Quartz-based relative sensing; specific design depends on the instrument.
sensing_family.superconducting: Superconducting sensing; no representative device is present in the initial public dataset.

distinctions.measures: Gravity acceleration or relative gravity difference
